notes:
Summary / call notes: 
- Company background: mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics for SMB/upper-mid customers). Heavy historical docs, event data and user guides; want vector search across docs + event-derived metadata.
- Immediate driver: improve search relevance & support agent answers; replacing brittle keyword search.
- PoC flow agreed: start with Hosted API embeddings for content + metadata, push vectors to Qdrant (customer PoC) and evaluate retrieval latency and recall. If economics and latency profile OK, move to Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in VPC) for predictable throughput.
- Perf targets stated by CTO (quote): "we need p99 retrieval < 120ms at 150 QPS and batch embed throughput 50k docs/hr for nightly ingestion windows". Cost sensitivity: wants unit cost per query < $0.002 average.
- Integration notes: currently using S3 for raw docs, Airflow for batch jobs; wants Redwood SDKs and a recommended batch worker pattern. Also asked about connectors (direct Qdrant sync vs Redwood-hosted vector store caching).
- Security: must support SSO (SAML) with SCIM groups, audit trails retained 1 year, and optional KMS-managed keys for embeddings at rest. Data residency: primary US only for now.
- Technical concerns raised by infra lead: KV cache eviction behavior under hot key loads, model-fallback behavior for rate spikes, and how to test automatic routing to cheaper model variants.
- Sales notes: AE framed path: 1) hosted POC → measure latency/cost/relevance 2) Dedicated sizing & pricing review 3) 3-month reserved commit with SLAs.
- Quote from product manager: "if retrieval quality + cost look good we can flip 50% of paid accounts to semantic search next quarter".
- Next deliverables: Dedicated POC config (instance sizes, batch worker profile), cost worksheet (3 sizing scenarios), SAML mapping doc and sample SCIM payloads.
- Risk: procurement cycle may stretch 6-8 weeks; security wants penetration test report before Prod enablement.
